elements.nameOrigin: Greek: lithos (stone).

elements.nameOrigin: Latin: carbo, (charcoal).

elements.name: Oxygen
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: oxys and genes, (acid former).

elements.name: Fluorine
elements.nameOrigin: Latin: fluere (flow).

elements.name: Neon
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: neos (new).

elements.name: Sodium
elements.nameOrigin: Medieval Latin: sodanum, (headache remedy); symbol from Latin natrium, (sodium carbonate).

elements.name: Magnesium
elements.nameOrigin: From Magnesia ancient city in district of Thessaly, Greece.

elements.name: Aluminum
elements.nameOrigin: Latin: alumen, aluminis, (alum).

elements.name: Silicon
elements.nameOrigin: Latin: silex, silicus, (flint).

elements.name: Phosphorus
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: phosphoros, (bringer of light).

elements.name: Sulfur
elements.nameOrigin: Latin: sulphur (brimstone).

elements.name: Chlorine
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: chlôros (greenish yellow).

elements.name: Argon
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: argos (inactive).

elements.name: Potassium
elements.nameOrigin: English: pot ash; symbol from Latin: kalium, (alkali).

elements.name: Calcium
elements.nameOrigin: Latin: calx, calcis (lime).

elements.name: Scandium
elements.nameOrigin: Latin: Scandia, Scandinavia.

elements.name: Titanium
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: titanos (Titans).

elements.name: Vanadium
elements.nameOrigin: From Scandinavian goddess, Vanadis.

elements.name: Chromium
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: chrôma (color).

elements.name: Manganese
elements.nameOrigin: Latin: magnes (magnet); Italian: manganese.

elements.name: Iron
elements.nameOrigin: Anglo-Saxon: iron; symbol from Latin: ferrum (iron).

elements.name: Cobalt
elements.nameOrigin: German: kobold (goblin).

elements.name: Nickel
elements.nameOrigin: German: kupfernickel (false copper).

elements.name: Copper
elements.nameOrigin: Symbol from Latin: cuprum (island of Cyprus famed for its copper mines).

elements.name: Zinc
elements.nameOrigin: German: zink (German for tin).

elements.name: Gallium
elements.nameOrigin: Latin: Gallia (France).

elements.name: Germanium
elements.nameOrigin: Latin: Germania (Germany).

elements.name: Arsenic
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: arsenikon; Latin: arsenicum, (both names for yellow pigment).

elements.name: Selenium
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: selênê (moon).

elements.name: Bromine
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: brômos (stench).

elements.name: Krypton
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: kryptos (hidden).

elements.name: Rubidium
elements.nameOrigin: Latin: rubidus (deep red); the color its salts impart to flames.

elements.name: Strontium
elements.nameOrigin: From the Scottish town, Strontian.

elements.name: Yttrium
elements.nameOrigin: From the Swedish village, Ytterby, where one of its minerals was first found.

elements.name: Zirconium
elements.nameOrigin: From the mineral, zircon.

elements.name: Niobium
elements.nameOrigin: From Niobe; daughter of the mythical Greek king Tantalus.

elements.name: Molybdenum
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: molybdos (lead).

elements.name: Technetium
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: technêtos (artificial).

elements.name: Ruthenium
elements.nameOrigin: Latin: Ruthenia (Russia).

elements.name: Rhodium
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: rhodon (rose). Its salts give a rosy solution.

elements.name: Palladium
elements.nameOrigin: Named after the asteroid, Pallas, discovered in 1803.

elements.name: Silver
elements.nameOrigin: Anglo-Saxon: siolful, (silver); symbol from Latin: argentium.

elements.name: Cadmium
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: kadmeia (ancient name for calamine (zinc oxide)).

elements.name: Indium
elements.nameOrigin: Latin: indicum (color indigo), the color it shows in a spectroscope.

elements.name: Tin
elements.nameOrigin: Named after Etruscan god, Tinia; symbol from Latin: stannum (tin).

elements.name: Antimony
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: anti and monos (not alone); symbol from mineral stibnite.

elements.name: Tellurium
elements.nameOrigin: Latin: tellus (earth).

elements.name: Iodine
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: iôeides (violet colored).

elements.name: Xenon
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: xenos (strange).
elements.discoverers: Sir William Ramsay; M. W. Travers

elements.name: Cesium
elements.nameOrigin: Latin: coesius (sky blue); for the blue lines of its spectrum.

elements.name: Barium
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: barys (heavy or dense).

elements.name: Lanthanum
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: lanthanein (to be hidden).

elements.name: Cerium
elements.nameOrigin: Named after the asteroid, Ceres, discovered two years before the element.
elements.discoverers: W. von Hisinger, J. Berzelius, M. Klaproth

elements.name: Praseodymium
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: prasios and didymos (green twin); from its green salts.

elements.name: Neodymium
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: neos and didymos (new twin).

elements.name: Promethium
elements.nameOrigin: Named for the Greek god, Prometheus.
elements.discoverers: J.A. Marinsky, L.E. Glendenin, C.D. Coryell

elements.name: Samarium
elements.nameOrigin: Named after the mineral samarskite.

elements.name: Europium
elements.nameOrigin: Named for the continent of Europe.

elements.name: Gadolinium
elements.nameOrigin: Named after the mineral gadolinite.

elements.name: Terbium
elements.nameOrigin: Named after Ytterby, a village in Sweden.

elements.name: Dysprosium
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: dysprositos (hard to get at).

elements.name: Holmium
elements.nameOrigin: From Holmia, the Latinized name for Stockholm, Sweden.

elements.name: Erbium
elements.nameOrigin: Named after the Swedish town, Ytterby.

elements.name: Thulium
elements.nameOrigin: From Thule ancient name of Scandinavia.

elements.name: Ytterbium
elements.nameOrigin: Named for the Swedish village of Ytterby.

elements.name: Lutetium
elements.nameOrigin: Named for the ancient name of Paris, Lutecia.

elements.name: Hafnium
elements.nameOrigin: From Hafnia, the Latin name of Copenhagen.

elements.name: Tantalum
elements.nameOrigin: From king Tantalus of Greek mythology, father of Niobe.

elements.name: Tungsten
elements.nameOrigin: Swedish: tung sten (heavy stone): symbol from its German name wolfram.
elements.discoverers: Fausto and Juan José de Elhuyar

elements.name: Rhenium
elements.nameOrigin: Latin: Rhenus, the Rhine River.
elements.discoverers: Walter Noddack, Ida Tacke, Otto Berg

elements.name: Osmium
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: osmê (odor).

elements.name: Iridium
elements.nameOrigin: Latin: iris (rainbow).

elements.name: Platinum
elements.nameOrigin: Spanish: platina (little silver).

elements.name: Gold
elements.nameOrigin: Anglo-Saxon: geolo (yellow); symbol from Latin: aurum (shining dawn).

elements.name: Mercury
elements.nameOrigin: From the Roman god Mercury; symbol from Latin: hydrargyrus (liquid silver).

elements.name: Thallium
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: thallos (green twig), for a bright green line in its spectrum.

elements.name: Lead
elements.nameOrigin: Anglo-Saxon: lead; symbol from Latin: plumbum.

elements.name: Bismuth
elements.nameOrigin: German: bisemutum, (white mass), Now spelled wismut.

elements.name: Polonium
elements.nameOrigin: Named for Poland, native country of Marie Curie.

elements.name: Astatine
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: astatos (unstable).

elements.name: Radon
elements.nameOrigin: Variation of the name of another element, radium.

elements.name: Francium
elements.nameOrigin: Named for France, the nation of its discovery.

elements.name: Radium
elements.nameOrigin: Latin: radius (ray).

elements.name: Actinium
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: akis, aktinos (ray).

elements.name: Thorium
elements.nameOrigin: Named for Thor, Norse god of thunder.

elements.name: Protactinium
elements.nameOrigin: Greek: proto and actinium (parent of actinium); it forms actinium when it radioactively decays.
elements.discoverers: Fredrich Soddy, John Cranston, Otto Hahn, Lise Meitner

elements.name: Uranium
elements.nameOrigin: Named for the planet Uranus.

elements.name: Neptunium
elements.nameOrigin: Named for the planet Neptune.

elements.name: Plutonium
elements.nameOrigin: Named for the planet Pluto.

elements.name: Americium
elements.nameOrigin: Named for the American continent, by analogy with europium.

elements.name: Curium
elements.nameOrigin: Named in honor of Pierre and Marie Curie.

elements.name: Berkelium
elements.nameOrigin: Named after Berkeley, California the city of its discovery.

elements.name: Californium
elements.nameOrigin: Named after the state and University of California.

elements.name: Einsteinium
elements.nameOrigin: Named in honor of the scientist Albert Einstein.
elements.discoverers: Argonne, Los Alamos, U of Calif

elements.name: Fermium
elements.nameOrigin: Named in honor of the scientist Enrico Fermi.
elements.discoverers: Argonne, Los Alamos, U of Calif

elements.name: Mendelevium
elements.nameOrigin: Named in honor of the scientist Dmitri Ivanovitch Mendeleyev, who devised the periodic table.

elements.name: Nobelium
elements.nameOrigin: Named in honor of Alfred Nobel, who invented dynamite and founded Nobel prize.

elements.name: Lawrencium
elements.nameOrigin: Named in honor of Ernest O. Lawrence, inventor of the cyclotron.

elements.name: Rutherfordium
elements.nameOrigin: Named in honor of Ernest Rutherford

elements.name: Dubnium
elements.nameOrigin: Named after the city of Dubna, the site of the JINR.

elements.name: Seaborgium
elements.nameOrigin: Named in honor of Glenn Seaborg, American physical chemist known for research on transuranium elements.
elements.discoverers: Soviet Nuclear Research/ U. of Cal at Berkeley

elements.name: Bohrium
elements.nameOrigin: Named in honor of Niels Bohr

elements.name: Hassium
elements.nameOrigin: Named in honor of Henri Hess, Swiss born Russian chemist known for work in thermodydamics.

elements.name: Meitnerium
elements.nameOrigin: Named in honor of Lise Mietner

elements.name: Darmstadtium
elements.nameOrigin: Named after the city of Darmstadt, Germany where  GSI Helmholtz Centre for Heavy Ion Research is located.

elements.name: Roentgenium
elements.nameOrigin: Named in honor of the physicist Wilhelm Roentgen.

elements.name: Copernicium
elements.nameOrigin: Named in honor of the astronomer Nicolaus Copernicus.
elements.discoverers: GSI Helmholtz Centre for Heavy Ion Research

elements.name: Nihonium
elements.nameOrigin: Named after the country of Japan.

elements.name: Flerovium
elements.nameOrigin: Named after the Flerov Laboratory of Nuclear Reactions of the Joint Institute for Nuclear Research in Dubna, Russia.

elements.name: Moscovium
elements.nameOrigin: Named after the city of Moscov.

elements.name: Livermorium
elements.nameOrigin: Named after the Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory in the United States.

elements.name: Tennessine
elements.nameOrigin: Named after the state of Tennessee in United States.
elements.discoverers: Joint Institute for Nuclear Research/Oak Ridge National Laboratory

elements.name: Oganesson
elements.nameOrigin: Named in honor of the scientist Yuri Oganessian.
